tasks.title: E19 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E19 (Research and content workbench). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E19.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E19/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E19/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

Edit only owned_paths; do not edit the frozen design, another task, shared contracts/configuration, root project, CI, request files or AI-USE-LOG.md. Recheck files and other docs/build/*/tasks.json before creation because plans are concurrent. At planning time hub/, ui/, knowledge/ and eval/ do not exist, and contracts/config have pharmacy artifacts only. Production files below are future creates, not replacements for existing modules. Test subdirectories are new allocations within docs/tdd/E19.md:971. No git commands. English only, no em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash.

SYSTEM 6 requires uv --project hub, pnpm and generated models/import contracts. Domains import only their own domain, kernel and allowed standard library. Cross-module imports end at application.ports. No workbench access to records/checks/reports/episodes/participation/assistant/vault or GroundLink; no clinical path depends on workbench.

Part A Q1/Q18 override E19 sections 1/14.14/T-E19-15: eligible patient_instruction needs no clinical sign-off and carries not_clinically_reviewed, while independent technical/source/purpose/rights/applicability checks remain. Q2 requires NASA full text or documented non-NASA permission, otherwise metadata only. Q3 enables Exa exactly when the environment key exists, public lexicon questions only; no .env loading or saved secrets. D5 uses generated ErrorEnvelope on wire; D6 keeps actor-wide mission-life identity including operation/target/parameters/body; D7 moves operational limits to bounded HubSettings; D17 uses internal tasks with public_kind=None and no research Job kinds. D1 preserves existing warning/session pins. Flight hubs do not run research workers (SYSTEM 3/11); ground/editor hosts do.

Never implement ResearchTx, IdGenerator, a feature command ledger/queue/retry scheduler, independent audit hash chain or local crash/publication framework. The missing secondary-store/artifact/audit protocol is existing R-E10-16, extended by PLAN request 1. Exact E10 export/DTO agreement is R-E10-14 and PLAN request 2. Authentication/roster/mission matching is PLAN request 3. Those proposals are not implemented ports. Wait for coordinator-approved exact provider declarations before dependent bindings; use only existing documented protocols plus E01 kernel.testing in hermetic component tests. Never create an invented provider copy or permissive production fake. Full acceptance requires real providers, not these fakes. Report newly missing declarations to the coordinator without guessing. docs/requests/E19.md is absent and outside this edit scope; canonical filing is a coordinator prerequisite.

Tests first, with each T-E19 ID and its R/V/story/invariant trace from E19 section 12. Fixtures are derived from admitted configuration/public source records; generated private canaries stay in fixtures/eval under explicit test profiles. Check zero/negative/empty/maximum/over-limit, changed hashes/units/pins, NaN/infinity and malformed external input where applicable. Property-test parsers and pure rules. No safety mapping changes. Domain has no wall clock, I/O or mutable module state. Runtime preconditions use typed errors, not assert. Every loop/page/cache/body/subprocess/call/retry has a registered finite bound and deadline. Storage/I/O/integrity/configuration/authorization errors propagate, never become fallback success. A bug gets a failing regression first and the complete hub suite after its fix.

Done means assigned tests and every gate pass with prerequisites implemented, no missing-test skips/xfails or vacuous off-state acceptance, and evidence identifies traces and remaining limitations. Final epic acceptance also requires T6 real-stack journeys, independent review, green CI and coordinator AI log entries. Component green does not claim whole-epic completion.

Build E19 sections 3.1 to 3.8, the pure/local port inventory of 4.1, section 8 validation and section 12 domain obligations; paths and filenames come from E19 section 13 (docs/tdd/E19.md:963). Leave all repositories/transactions to T2, network/extraction/parser adapters to T3, workflow orchestration to T4, rendering/publication to T5 and assembly/wire/UI to T6. T1 is the sole author of local domain and ports, and publishes their agreed shapes before other tasks use them. Do not invent fields of the design's underspecified placeholder types; request the exact missing fields. Local data-only implementation details may use the least structure needed by the specified rules; shared shapes wait for the provider.

Implement LexiconTerm, PublicLexicon, ResearchQuestion, QueryState, DiscoveryQuery, QueryEvent, DiscoveryResult and GuardRejection from E19 3.1 (docs/tdd/E19.md:79); CompletenessAssessment, SourceReview, ReviewKind, Attestation, LicenseRecordRef, Claim/ClaimRevision/ClaimReview, UseApproval and ApprovalState from 3.2; assess_ceiling/display_status from 3.3; Promotion/PromotionState from 3.5; DocumentationRelease and coverage formulas from 3.6/3.7.
